```{r}
#| label: tbl-vars
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false
#| tbl-cap: "Variable definitions and data sources"
#| tbl-pos: "H"

vars <- tibble(var = names(ndr))

# meta data
meta <- bind_rows(
  metaout,
  metalm %>% rename(Code = ATC)
)
vars <- left_join(vars, meta, by = c("var" = "Variable"))

vars <- vars %>%
  mutate(
    order = 1:n(),
    Code = str_trim(Code),
    Code = str_replace_all(Code, "ICD", "ICD-10"),
    Code = case_when(
      is.na(Register) ~ Code,
      Period == "0-" ~ str_replace_all(Code, "ICD-10", "ICD-9/10"),
      TRUE ~ Code
    ),
    Code = str_replace_all(Code, ":", " "),
    Code = str_replace_all(Code, ",", ", "),
    Code = str_replace_all(Code, "OP ", "Procedure "),
    Code = str_replace_all(Code, "Ekod ", "Cause "),
  )

# data sources and footnotes
vars <- vars %>%
  mutate(
    data0 = if_else(str_detect(var, "^(shf_|sos_|scb_|lopnr|censdtm)", negate = T), "NDR", NA),
    data1 = if_else(str_detect(var, "^shf_"), "SwedeHF", NA),
    data2 = case_when(
      str_detect(var, "sos_com_") & !is.na(Code) ~ paste0("NPR: ", Code),
      str_detect(var, "sos_out_") & !str_detect(var, "death") & !is.na(Code) ~ paste0("NPR: ", Code)
    ),
    data3 = if_else(str_detect(var, "scb_famtype|scb_education|scb_dispincome"), "LISA", NA),
    data4 = if_else(str_detect(var, "scb_countryofbirth"), "RTP", NA),
    data5 = case_when(
      str_detect(var, "sos_med_") & !is.na(Code) ~ paste0("NPDR: ", Code)
    ),
    data6 = case_when(str_detect(var, "death") & is.na(Code) ~ "NCDR"),
    data7 = if_else(str_detect(var, "sos_hfhdtm"), "NPR: I110, I130, I132, I255, I420, I423, I425-9, I43, I50, J81, K761, R570", NA),
    footnote1 = if_else(str_detect(var, "scb_"), footnote_marker_alphabet(1, format = "latex"), ""),
    footnote2 = if_else(str_detect(var, "sos_com_"), footnote_marker_alphabet(2, format = "latex"), ""),
    footnote3 = if_else(str_detect(var, "sos_hfhdtm"), footnote_marker_alphabet(3, format = "latex"), ""),
    footnote4 = if_else(str_detect(var, "sos_med"), footnote_marker_alphabet(4, format = "latex"), "")
  ) %>%
  unite(datasource, starts_with("data"), sep = "; ", na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  unite(footnote, starts_with("footnote"), sep = "") %>%
  arrange(order) %>%
  mutate(datasource = paste0(datasource, footnote)) %>%
  select(var, datasource)

footnotetext <- c(
  "From the year preceding baseline.",
  "Derived from diagnoses/operations in all positions, except for Malignant cancer that is only in main position, in-patient and out-patient speciality care within 5 years prior to index (ICD-10)/1987 (ICD-9)/any time (however, see restrictions in the NPR and code usage) for procedure codes, except for Malignant cancer that are within 3 years prior to index.",
  "Derived from all position in-patient and out-patient speciality care.",
  "Derived from ATC codes from dispensed medications within 120 days prior to index up untill 7 days after index."
)

vars <- vars %>%
  mutate(
    # so no probs
    var = sanitize_text(var)
  )

default_kable(vars,
  escape = FALSE,
  longtable = TRUE,
  font_size = 9,
  col.names = c("Variable", "Data source")
) %>%
  footnote(
    footnote_order = c("general", "symbol", "alphabet"),
    general_title = "",
    general = c(
      "Abbreviations: SwedeHF, The Swedish Heart Failure Registry; NPR, The National Patient Register; LISA, Longitudinal integrated database for health insurance and labour market studies; RTP, Register of the Total Population; NPDR, The National Prescribed Drug Register; NCDR, The National Cause of Death Register, NDR: National Diabetes Register"
    ),
    alphabet = footnotetext,
    threeparttable = T
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "6cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "8cm")
```
